current_business_reality.summary: Opportunity generation is judged insufficient and remains relationship-led. Goals progress from two monthly closings toward a delegated multi-agent business. A combined relationship base exists but lacks complete, segmented, system-governed records. External coaching covers development and recruiting, while operating accountability is mostly self-held or absent. Core workflows are articulated, but execution and follow-through remain leader-centered. Production, gross, and expense figures are reported, but their periods, reconciliation, and owner economics remain unresolved. Organization, time management, and distraction are the operator-identified constraints. Equal profit and business contribution coexist with a reported concentration of work on the operator. Additional help, delegation, and daily CRM use are identified as necessary capacity changes.

desired_business_reality.summary: Goals progress from two monthly closings toward a delegated multi-agent business.

business_model_reality.summary: value creation: Residential clients receive listing, buyer, and transaction coordination through direct operator involvement. demand entry: Demand enters mainly through SOI contact and local networking; farming, paid leads, reviews, and online presence remain prospective lanes. conversion: Active opportunities are reportedly followed through joint outreach, but source-stage denominators and aging are unavailable. delivery: Listing and buyer workflows are defined, with transaction-coordinator support and the operator retaining primary follow-through. value capture: Transaction revenue is reported through gross and expense figures without a verified commission-to-owner-profit bridge. leverage: A business partner, transaction coordinator, and title support provide partial leverage while core judgment and workload remain centralized. concentration: Demand is concentrated in relationships and execution is concentrated in the operator; source and key-person shares are unmeasured.

territory_states.state_summary: The combined SOI contains 392 contacts, about half attributed to the operator, with roughly 50 personal relationships believed top-of-mind. The database is an incomplete spreadsheet without email completion or segmentation and receives outside update support. Postcards recur every five to six weeks while personal outreach is random and acknowledged as under-systematized.

The operator reports insufficient current opportunity generation. SOI contact and local networking are available lanes; other named lanes are intentions rather than evidenced engines. Current evidence cannot separate generation scarcity from capture, qualification, follow-up, or market effects.
The governed evidence makes follow-up / conversion material, but the accepted state does not establish a separate conclusion for it.

Listing, buyer, lead, transaction, and recruiting steps are articulated. The operator retains primary transaction follow-through while using coordinator support as needed. Operational repeatability is unverified despite the operator describing current processes as working.

Coaching is present for business development and recruiting. Routine business execution is primarily self-accountable or unowned. The operator attributes limitation to organization, time management, and distraction.

Units, sales volume, gross, and expenses are reported for incompletely defined periods. Reported units and volume imply an average sale price below the separately stated average. Agent net, owner compensation, owner profit, cash, reserves, and contribution by source or closing are not established.

Profit and business contribution are reported as equal while the operator reports performing most team work. The business partner participates in joint lead and client follow-up. No person-level team synthesis is authorized for the reported partner relationship.

The operator has explicit production, delegation, team, and office goals across multiple horizons. The reported current team pace is below the near-term monthly closing target. The growth plan lacks evidenced demand, economics, role, and process gates.

e_to_p_state.rationale: A defined current operating model and desired delegated future are present, while feasibility and economics remain only partly governed.
Core workflows are articulated, but repeatability, data completeness and transfer from the operator are not directly corroborated.
A database and CRM direction exist, but governed completeness and daily operating use remain unfinished.
External coaching exists, while recurring operating ownership and inspection remain mostly self-held or absent.
Coaching is present for development and recruiting; application to the active operating constraint is not directly evidenced.
The governed assessment does not establish an applied ongoing-education loop tied to a current capability gap.

diagnostic_lens_traversal.focus_or_stop_result: The governed evidence does not separate opportunity, conversion and capacity cleanly; the operator label (insufficient) remains one report, not the diagnosis.
Evaluate how purposefully the operator is building the model required by the desired outcome across the material side of the governing fork.
Inspect the relationship asset's size, quality, inflow, activation, decay and economic relevance to the stated goal.
Determine which sources actually create qualified opportunity, their economics and execution fit, and whether the portfolio meets the goal.
Trace opportunity through the complete conversion and relationship-continuity chain and locate governed leakage.
Determine whether repeatable value creation depends on memory/personality/heroics or governed models, systems, tools, cadence, measurement and ownership.
Reconcile actual economic production, owner outcome and capacity to reinvest without confusing transaction volume or GCI with profit.
When opportunity is sufficient or growth is desired, determine which capacity, service, system, role, team, leadership or economic mechanism prevents leverage.
Leader-centered execution without a governed relationship, delegation, measurement, and accountability system.
Hand the validated complete diagnostic state to the frozen Five Futures V2 and One Move V2 contracts without altering their semantics.
